calls.title: Elyse & Ashley
calls.summary: Elyse Fox's onboarding process was discussed, emphasizing her role in product marketing and how it intersects with Scott's responsibilities in technical marketing. The meeting outlined the structured collaboration between them, including scheduled meetings and shared resources. Elyse received early access to essential sales enablement materials and AI tools to support her integration. The discussion also highlighted the importance of familiarizing her with technical aspects and relevant team members for a cohesive work environment. Additionally, the meeting addressed the evolving customer success function and the need for strong collaboration across teams to enhance both marketing and sales enablement efforts.
calls.keywords: Onboarding, Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, AI Tools, Customer Success, Terminal Usage
